text:
Jordan (Sales): MeridianBank wants SOC2 excerpts + a signed pen-test letter for the POC. They also asked if we can provision a private dataroom and include redacted KMS flow diagrams. Need turnaround ~48h.

Alex Chen: We can share a redacted SOC2 PDF and our pen-test attestation template. For the signed letter we require an NDA + named signatory (full name, title, email). We don't share raw scans or private keys.

Priya N: FYI - dataroom requests go through security ops. Use the dataroom request form and attach NDA. Link: https://redwood.example.com/assurance/dataroom-request . Include TTL, customer contact, and signatory info.

Jordan (Sales): Customer also wants to know if a 2-week Dedicated trial will change pricing vs hosted free credits. Short answer?

Sam R: Hosted POC = charged off credits/usage. Dedicated trial requires a short-term reserved pool; legal/finance need signoff. I can run a quick estimate and a one-page quote. ETA 2h.

Alex Chen: Sample email to security (paste into form if helpful):

```
To: security@redwood.com
Subject: MeridianBank - Dataroom + Pen-test Signatory
Customer: MeridianBank
Contact: ciso@meridianbank.com
Signatory: Jane Doe, CISO, jane.doe@meridianbank.com
NDA: attached
Artifacts: SOC2 excerpt (redacted), KMS custody diagram (redacted)
TTL: 14 days
```

Priya N: Note: network diagrams must be redacted for internal IPs; we will not upload raw vulnerability reports to the public dataroom. If they insist, escalate to SOC.

Security Ops Bot: Ticket created: SEC-2026-874. Dataroom provisioning queued; expected SLA 1 business day.

Jordan (Sales): Thanks — I'm sending NDA/signatory now. @Sam R please attach the Dedicated trial estimate when ready.

Sam R: Will post estimate in this thread in ~2h.
